question: Does the raw-family norm-and-range-preserving affine selection policy motivated by Step42 retain competitive predictive performance and numerical-certificate coverage on previously unassessed task periods?

household_power2008.dataset: UCI235 Individual Household Electric Power Consumption
household_power2008.freshness_scope: Previously unassessed historical task-year within a previously retained source archive; not forward-calendar validation relative to2009/2010 studies

jena_temperature2018.freshness_scope: Forward task-year after previously assessed2016/2017; new official source archives within a known domain

metro_traffic2018.freshness_scope: Forward assessment after the prior2017 task; exposed November2017 measurements are explicitly permitted as chronological training/history

forecasting.input_rule: Own-target hourly snapshots from origin minus23hours through origin, oldest to newest; origin is24hours before target
forecasting.missing_rule: Exclude only dates lacking a required timestamp or containing a predeclared missing marker; no numeric outlier-based exclusion
forecasting.invalid_panel_policy: Stop and report infeasibility; no outcome-driven task replacement

method.maps: Unchanged inherited18-map factory: raw2, Nystrom4, KAHM12
method.head: P1R1C1: norm projection enabled, exact intercept recentering enabled, normalized clipping enabled
method.other_seeds: Sensitivity analyses on the same observations; never independent replications or selection candidates
method.baseline_panel: Unchanged inherited same-information44-candidate panel, with declared seed substituted only in stochastic estimator parameters
method.selection: Exact pooled physical-unit development MSE over3 expanding folds; lexical candidate identity breaks ties
method.final_assessment: Only frozen development-selected raw, Nystrom, KAHM, all-map, ordinary and ridge policy identities; deduplicate equal identities; no full assessment oracle grid

primary_endpoint.predictive_rule: 20*SSE_raw <=21*SSE_reference for every task and both comparators, on identical task query cohorts
primary_endpoint.zero_reference_rule: Use the cross-multiplied inequality directly: with zero reference SSE, only zero raw SSE passes; report ratio as null
primary_endpoint.certificate_rule: Every primary-policy honest binary64 assessment packet must be accepted under the unchanged span*2^-40 numerical contract
primary_endpoint.claim_rule: All predictive conditions, primary certificate coverage and independent scientific audit must pass
primary_endpoint.scope: Finite-cohort practical tolerance; no population noninferiority, statistical significance or unseen-domain claim

secondary_analyses.stability: All seed-specific and calendar-month paired loss results; descriptive only

certificate_assay.honest: Original reported binary64 value and self-consistent packet
certificate_assay.quantized: Round physical output through float32 then back to binary64; generate a self-consistent packet for that reported value
certificate_assay.acceptance_rule: Acceptance must exactly equal an independent rational comparison of reported-value discrepancy to span*2^-40; rounded values are not assumed invalid
certificate_assay.control: Explicitly limited identity-binding-only check, with no numerical-discrepancy enforcement
certificate_assay.misbinding: Fixed wrong-query, wrong-deployment and stale-feature challenges on the first chronological query of each selected certified head
certificate_assay.scope: Numerical-contract and misbinding demonstrations; no authentication, ideal-feature-transform or future-label-accuracy guarantee

cost_assay.policies: Actual selected certified policies and ordinary/ridge controls, deduplicated
cost_assay.queries: 32 deterministic equal-stratum chronological assessment queries per task, or all if fewer than32
primitives: checker with trusted cached features/static context
cost_assay.counterbalance: Alternate full verified/unverified ordering by selected query index
cost_assay.scope: Measured local implementation costs, with raw repetitions retained; no speedup threshold or service-level guarantee

access_and_execution.prefreeze_allowed: Prior-study records, official metadata, opaque source transport, timestamp/header parsing and exact declared missing-marker checks only
access_and_execution.numeric_access: New measurement values decoded only after final protocol/source seal and independent preflight PASS
access_and_execution.selection_gate: Independent development/selection audit before fresh assessment
access_and_execution.assessment_order: Commit all selected policy/seed predictions for each query before revealing that query's target; historical own-target lag observations remain permitted
access_and_execution.failure_policy: Retain evidence and stop at a failed gate; no silent postfreeze scientific edits

scientific_claim_limits: Freshness is relative to retained workflow exposure evidence, not an absolute historical never-seen assertion
Three known domains do not establish unseen-domain generalization
Raw/Nystrom deterministic results across seeds are not additional samples
Family search pools differ in size
Coefficient/range properties concern the exact fitted stored-feature reference; operational output has the certified numerical discrepancy
No exact optimizer, ideal transform, raw-input robustness, authentication or future-label coverage is certified
